predictions.selection_reason: New form added for bulk session deletion -> exposes sensitive session management functionality -> potential CSRF or authorization issues
predictions.source_summary: Authenticated user session management interface - accessible only to logged-in users via LoginRequiredMixin
predictions.sink_summary: Bulk session deletion endpoint that deletes all user sessions except the current one via Session.objects.delete()
predictions.guard_summary: CSRF token present in form; LoginRequiredMixin ensures authentication; SessionMixin filters to user's own sessions; get_object() excludes current session from deletion
predictions.risk_pattern: New bulk session deletion form exposes sensitive session management functionality - allows authenticated users to terminate all other active sessions
predictions.context_summary: Form added to session list template that allows users to delete all sessions except current one; protected by authentication and CSRF tokens; uses Django's DeletionMixin for bulk deletion
unresolved_facts: Exact implementation of DeletionMixin.delete() method behavior
Whether session deletion has additional authorization checks beyond user ownership
How session deletion affects concurrent user activity

top_sast_rules.description: Finds uses of symmetric cryptography algorithms that are weak, obsolete, or otherwise unaccepted. The key lengths allowed are 128, 192, and 256 bits. These are all the key lengths supported by AES, so any application of AES is considered acceptable.
